snippet.title: Last Night Last Call - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Can you solve a murder with nothing but your wits, your cocktail shaker, and your silver tongue? In this mystery visual novel, your customers are the key. So long as the liquor flows, so does the conversation - but who has the answers you seek, and who has blood on their hands? 

Coming to Steam and Nintendo Switch.
